name: Matriarch
description: A supervisor, workers and a read-only review crew across several models drive every PR through CI, review, fixes and merge. Starts in dry run.

cover.alt: Matriarch's sidebar in Orca: a running supervisor, PR counts by state, and a timeline of each worktree's work, beside the name and tagline.

screenshots.alt: The timeline across two projects: a row per worktree or PR, colored by state, under a strip counting what ran at once.
screenshots.caption: Every PR from first commit to merge, across your projects, on one timeline.

screenshots.alt: The board: PR cards grouped by state, with the agent and model on each, CI, rounds used, and what dry run would do next.
screenshots.caption: The board shows what each PR waits on, and in dry run what Matriarch would do next.

screenshots.alt: The sidebar beside its settings: supervisor, workers and a review crew, each with its own agent, model and effort.
screenshots.caption: Pick each role's agent, model and effort in Settings: no config files to edit.

commands.title: Matriarch: Turn autopilot on or off

settings.title: Autopilot
settings.description: Off: dry run, Matriarch watches and shows what it would do. On: it messages workers, updates branches and merges as each repository's .orca/matriarch.json allows.
